Barbell step-up TOP FINISH. Ref1 identity ref2 exercise master ref3 near-top edit target. Keep reference3 exactly same athlete torso/head, bar/plates/grips, lead leg and planted lead shoe, box and scene. ONLY move trailing leg's foot forward onto box top beside lead foot so BOTH feet are fully planted shoulder width apart on box. Both knees extended naturally, torso tall; no knee drive, no jump. Do not change bar height, scale, camera, equipment or colors. 1536x1024 black background. No labels/text.
cues: Rack the bar on the upper traps and place the lead foot fully on the box.
Drive through the lead heel without pushing off the floor leg.
Straighten the lead leg and bring the trailing leg up.
Stand tall with both feet securely on the box.
Step the trailing leg back down under control.
Return the trailing foot quietly to the floor before the next repetition.
reuseReason: Controlled step-down passes same drive configuration and ends at original lead-foot-on-box setup.
